out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL EMAIL COPY OF POLICY.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: containers of ingredients under the prep table across from cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the plumbing under the 3 compartment sink is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled. Condensation was observed dripping on pan (used to place cook chicken) on prep surface.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PAN WAS DESIGNATED TO COLLECT CONDENSATION. ANOTHER SANITIZED PAN TO BE USED FOR FOOD.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure.
